title: [main] Price Groups of Subscription Packages are not considered.
summary: On the Assign Subscription Lines page, offered subscription packages are now always filtered to the customer's price group plus packages without a price group. Customers without a price group no longer see price-group-restricted packages, and the fallback that offered every package is removed.
key_points: Filter now always applied to offered packages based on customer's price group plus unrestricted packages
Customers without a price group now only see packages without a price group restriction
Removed fallback filter clearing that previously allowed all packages when no match found
Page does not open if no qualifying packages exist for the customer
Automatic selection behavior unchanged; new test added for customer-without-price-group scenario
quote: Always filter the offered packages to the customer's price group plus packages without a price group.
